set.body:
Source: review finding in SshCommand.scala:53 and the existing SSH security ADR.

Problem:
without BatchMode=yes, failed public-key authentication can wait for password or keyboard-interactive input and be misclassified as a command timeout.

Acceptance:
- Make non-interactive authentication the safe library default, normally with -o BatchMode=yes.
- If interactive authentication remains supported, require an explicit opt-in mode and document its process/TTY ownership.
- Classify authentication refusal separately from transport or command timeout.
- Revise the ADR and add argv plus failure-classification tests.
set.title: P6f.7: Make SSH authentication non-interactive by default
